variants.headline: The city-state vote goes our way
body: Our effort to sway a city-state's election has succeeded. The count finished where we intended.

variants.headline: The city-state vote goes against us
body: Our effort to sway a city-state's election has come to nothing. The count finished against us.

variants.headline: A quiet success in {{cityState}}
body: Letters from {{cityState}} relate that the election there has ended to our advantage. Patient work by our people in the city earned the result, and the government's judgment in backing that work stands confirmed.

variants.headline: The failed election bid owes us answers
body: Citizens, the attempt to sway a city-state's election has come to nothing. Someone chose that ground, and the public has yet to hear the case for it. A failed operation owes an accounting, and this paper means to keep asking until it gets one.

variants.headline: The election, measured in influence
body: The one firm measure of the operation is the {{influence}}-point change in our influence with the city-state. Whatever else the attempt did, this number is what can be counted, and the next such effort will be weighed against it.

variants.headline: Our diplomat takes up post in {{civilization}}
body: We have posted a diplomat to {{civilization}}. The envoy will speak for us at that court and send home word of what its ministers intend.

variants.headline: A diplomat posted abroad
body: We have posted a diplomat to a foreign capital. The envoy opens a direct line between our government and another major power; our records do not say which one.

variants.headline: An envoy established at {{capital}}
body: In the manner of former reigns, an envoy of ours is now established at {{capital}}, the seat of {{civilization}}. Letters will pass between the two courts, as letters between courts always have.

variants.headline: A diplomat goes to {{civilization}}
body: Our diplomat is in {{civilization}} tonight. The envoy speaks for us there, and listens. In the contest of courts, an ear at another table is worth a regiment in the field.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is caught and identified
body: A foreign spy at work inside our borders has been caught and identified. The government now knows whose service sent the intruder.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is killed
body: A foreign spy at work inside our borders has been caught, and did not survive it. The service that sent the intruder is known to the government.

variants.headline: Hear it! A spy is taken in {{cityName}}
body: Hear it, people of {{cityName}}! A foreign spy has been caught at work in your city. Caught, and stopped! Go about your business; the watch is awake.

variants.headline: A spy among us, caught!
body: Foreign eyes were at work in our streets, neighbors. They are caught now. The councils will keep their secrets, but this much is owed to the street: our watch was equal to it.

variants.headline: Our spy is detected abroad
body: One of our spies abroad has been detected at the work. The watchers there know an agent was operating against them, but not whose.

variants.headline: Our work in {{target}} loses its quiet
body: Our operation in {{target}} has been noticed. The other side knows an agent was at work; only the agent's employer stays hidden. An operation that loses its quiet is a spent operation, and someone chose that ground. The next such choice deserves a harder look.

variants.headline: Detected, and perhaps not empty-handed
body: Word reaches this paper that our agent abroad was noticed at the work. Even so, letters home suggest the attempt may have secured {{possibleTechnology}} for us, which would soften the misstep considerably.

variants.headline: Our spy is noticed in {{cityName}}
body: In this season one of ours was noticed at work in {{cityName}}. The other side knows an agent was in the city. Whose service sent the agent, the other side has not learned.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is detected at home
body: Our watchers have detected a foreign spy at work inside our borders. The intruder was noticed but not identified, and the service behind the work remains unknown.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is killed, unnamed
body: Our watchers have killed a foreign spy caught at work inside our borders. The intruder died unnamed, and whoever sent them stays hidden.

variants.headline: Notice: the watch is awake
body: This paper learns that our watchers have marked a foreign agent at work inside our borders. The agent's employer remains unknown. The counter-work goes on under the government's hand.

variants.headline: Someone was watching {{cityName}}
body: A foreign spy has been spotted at work in {{cityName}}. Nobody knows who sent them. The market filled its stalls as usual, but people counted their change a little more carefully.

variants.headline: Our spy is identified abroad
body: One of our spies has been identified at work abroad. The other side knows whose agent it was, and the quiet work there is over.

variants.headline: Our spy is killed abroad
body: One of our spies has been killed at work abroad. The other side knows whose agent it was, and the operation is ended with them.

variants.headline: Our spy is killed abroad, unnamed
body: One of our spies has been killed at work abroad. The watchers there stopped the agent without learning whose service sent them. Our hand in the matter stays hidden; the loss stays with us.

variants.headline: Named in {{target}}, and no one explains
body: One of ours stands named as a spy in {{target}}. An operation that ends with our name in another capital's mouth has failed at least half its work. Who weighed that risk, and for what gain? The public is owed the answer.

variants.headline: The cost of the quiet work in {{target}}
body: An agent of ours is dead in {{target}}, and {{target}} knows whose. The nation has paid twice over: once for the agent, once for the secrecy that agent kept. What the work bought in return, no one outside the service can yet say.

variants.headline: An agent of ours, unnamed
body: The state does not print the name, but the loss can be noted. One of our agents has died abroad in the secret work. What the agent gathered, and what the mission cost, stay with the office that sent them. The rest of us hold the debt.

variants.headline: Our spy may have gained {{possibleTechnology}}
body: One of our spies has finished work abroad without being noticed. The reports home suggest the operation may have obtained {{possibleTechnology}} for us.

variants.headline: The quiet account
body: The work abroad, in short:
Detection: none. Likely gain: {{possibleTechnology}}.
The years of study we did not spend are the years we keep.

variants.headline: Unnoticed in {{target}}
body: Our people worked {{target}} tonight without being detected, and the early word says the take may include {{possibleTechnology}}. If the gain holds, the gap in learning between the two nations narrows, and no workshop in either country will hear why.

variants.headline: Quiet win: possibly {{possibleTechnology}}
body: Nobody noticed us. Likely take: {{possibleTechnology}}. That is the whole story, and it is a good one.

variants.headline: Our spy takes up post in {{cityName}}
body: One of our spies is now stationed in {{cityName}}, a city of {{civilization}}. The work of watching that city begins from inside its walls.

variants.headline: A quiet posting to {{cityName}}
body: It is understood in reliable quarters that one of our people is now placed in {{cityName}}, of {{civilization}}. The nation's standing is kept by many kinds of work, and not all of them are loud.

variants.headline: One of ours goes to {{cityName}}
body: It is told that one of our quieter folk has gone to live in {{cityName}}, in the land of {{civilization}}. They will walk the markets, mind the talk, and send home what the wind carries.

variants.headline: Eyes inside {{cityName}}
body: A spy inside {{cityName}} is more than a listener. The posting is an early line on what {{civilization}} builds, moves and plans; news from inside a city arrives before any other. The quiet placements are where the next war shows first.

variants.headline: A diplomat of {{civilization}} arrives at our capital
body: A diplomat of {{civilization}} has taken up residence at our capital. The envoy opens a direct channel between the two governments, and the conversations begin.

variants.headline: A foreign diplomat arrives
body: A foreign diplomat has presented credentials at our capital. Our records do not say which power sent the envoy, but the channel between the two governments now runs direct.

variants.headline: An envoy from {{civilization}} at our court
body: This paper is pleased to record that an envoy of {{civilization}} is now received at our capital. Two governments that speak directly have less cause to speak sharply, and the channel is welcome on that account.

variants.headline: A listener at our table
body: A diplomat of {{civilization}} now sits at our capital. A good guest listens more than speaks, and we should assume the conversations travel home in full. Hospitality is right; carelessness is not. The paper's counsel is a warm welcome and an open eye.
